characters.name: Kongen

characters.description: En truende, usett makt bak godset—en brutal «eier» som opptrer som et monster i moderne forkledning og som katten til slutt lurer i dagslyset.
characters.look: A colossal troll about four times a man's height, round-shouldered and heavy, with long, matted, oatmeal-beige fur covering his head and face, two round yellow eyes that glow like lanterns, a big potato nose and a broad mouth with two blunt buck teeth. His huge bare hands are grey as stone. He wears a gigantic, worn olive-drab work jacket with the hood up and baggy grey work trousers, and goes barefoot on broad, hairy feet.

places.name: the Silver Estate
places.look: A country estate on a gentle rise among harvest fields: a long, elegant manor house made all of polished silver, with tall windows, a silver roof and chimneys, shining so brightly in the sun that it hurts the eyes. In front of it, three tall wrought gates stand one behind the other across a paved drive: the first of brass, the second of silver and the third of gold, each between two square stone gateposts with lamps. Behind it rises a low wooded ridge.

places.name: the Golden Dining Hall
places.look: A long dining hall inside the Silver Estate where everything is gold: gold walls and doors, gold chairs, a very long golden table, golden plates and goblets, two big crystal-and-gold chandeliers and even golden light switches by the door. Tall windows with heavy cream curtains look out on the three gates, and the floor is polished golden parquet.
